map_scripts.declaration: def getPlotAreaKm2(): an Earth-sized planet, 510,100,000 km2 over the map's plots (CyMap grid width x height): the DLL's default rule, declared; scripts generate their land at random, so no real region is measured
map_scripts.note: surface-based, while the Earth scenarios are land-based: on Earth Standard the two differ by about 27 % (the scenarios draw land larger than the sea)
map_scripts.skipped_why: non-ASCII bytes: the GitLab connector rewrites an edited file in UTF-8; their declaration would equal the DLL's default rule, so they keep the default (a log line names them)
